A '''charred potato''' is a [[potato]] burnt in a [[Mud Kiln|mud kiln]]. It heals only {{Value|Charred Potato|heals}}, compared with {{Value|Baked Potato|heals}} for a [[Baked Potato|baked potato]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/kiln/charred_potato.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Kilning ===
{{Recipes}}
A potato becomes a charred potato in a mud kiln in {{Value|Charred Potato|cook_time}}.

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating a charred potato takes {{Value|Charred Potato|eat_time}} and heals {{Value|Charred Potato|heals}}.
